jobs.economic_reason: Three other USD-quoted pairs must simultaneously show same-direction completed bodies >= their own prior ATR20, while target body <=0.25 own ATR20. Freeze shock direction/target close/ATR. Target must begin same-direction response on a later completed bar within 3 M5 bars; opposite peer impulse cancels. Only delayed target is traded. No ranking of accumulated returns, strongest/weakest selection, fitted residual equilibrium, residual hedge or volatility regime allocation. Closed currency strength, fitted residual, common-factor momentum, C2/G4/E1 stay closed. This is event transmission, not parameter rescue.
